issue_request: FHIR-15971 was Published/Persuasive with Modification and asked to extend the existing procedure-approachBodyStructure extension, already available on Procedure, to ServiceRequest, DeviceRequest, and DeviceUseStatement for anatomical approach site metadata.
initial_application: No Jira-keyed FHIR-15971 commit was found in the current core or Extension Pack histories. The extension was present in core by R4B source import commit c69d71aa213de86d55e0261339c15e4bacd509e6 with Procedure, ServiceRequest, DeviceRequest, and DeviceUseStatement contexts; later history renamed DeviceUseStatement to DeviceUsage and moved extension definitions out of core.

The current Extension Pack loads input/definitions/* and its procedure-approachBodyStructure definition includes Procedure, ServiceRequest, DeviceRequest, DeviceUsage, and version-specific DeviceUseStatement contexts. FHIR-22857 later added Specimen.collection to the same extension and is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No FHIR core source change was made. The authoritative source is the FHIR Extension Pack, and that external source already carries the required extension contexts.
